segments.sn55.32:1.3: Idha, bhikkhave, ariyasāvako buddhe aveccappasādena samannāgato hoti –
segments.sn55.32:1.4: itipi so bhagavā … pe … satthā devamanussānaṃ buddho bhagavāti.
segments.sn55.32:3.1: “Puna caparaṃ, bhikkhave, ariyasāvako vigatamalamaccherena cetasā agāraṃ ajjhāvasati muttacāgo payatapāṇi vossaggarato yācayogo dānasaṃvibhāgarato.
segments.sn55.32:3.3: Ime kho, bhikkhave, cattāro puññābhisandā kusalābhisandā sukhassāhārā”ti.
